Subject: Trial credits about to expire — can we extend for 1 week?

Hi Grace,

We're wrapping up an evaluation of Redwood for inference on our search ranking pipeline. The team is blocked on a final run: we need an extra week of credits to finish the throughput/latency checks before internal sign-off and issuing a PO.

Current trial expires Aug 1; could we get a 7-day extension or a small top-up (20k tokens) to finish the test? If useful I attached the usage snapshot.

Thanks — appreciate it.
Alex

I approved a 25,000 token credit top-up on the customer account; expiration set 30 days from issuance.
